items.prompt: Black to move. Find a strong move.

claims.statement: The engine's best move (Stockfish 19 lite, depth 16) is Ne4; the accepted move Ne4 is within 30 cp of it.
Before the move the knight on g5 attacks 3 squares that none of Black's pieces occupy.
After Ne4 the knight on e4 attacks 7 such squares.
h6 is at least 50 cp worse than the best move (engine, depth 16).

hints: List your pieces and ask which one has the worst job, or which feature of the position you could use.
Which of your pieces has the fewest squares to go to, and where would it have more?
A knight makes the move.
items.explain: Engine evidence (Stockfish 19 lite, depth 16, one thread): Ne4 is the top choice. Ne4 improves the knight: it attacks 3 squares not held by Black's own pieces from g5 and 7 from e4. Rule of thumb, not proved by the engine: a piece that reaches more squares can do more; the move that most improves the worst-placed piece is often a good quiet move.
